clipRange.title: Clip a part
clipRange.hint: Times as 0:30 or 1:05:20 or plain seconds. Only that part is requested from the server. Cuts land on the nearest keyframe, so a second either way is normal. Some sites refuse partial requests — YouTube among them — so use the Clip screen after downloading.
clipRange.invalid: The end must come after the start, and times must read 0:30 or 1:05:20 or plain seconds.
